headlines.title: [단독] " 보증금 없이 월세만 " 日기업 한국 상륙
headlines.summary: 월세시장 지각변동 일본 임대료 보증업체 제이리스 韓 진출 임박 세입자는 신용심사 받는 대신 목돈 부담 덜어 전세에서 월세로 빠르게 바뀌고 있는 한국 임대차 시장에 일본식 월세 보증 서비스가 상륙할 전망이다. 임차인의 월세 지급 능력을 심사해 보증을 서고 월세가 밀리면 보증회사가 임대인에게 대신 지급하는 방식이다.

key_headlines.title: Government Allocates 84 Trillion Won for Semiconductor Megaproject Infrastructure Over 10 Years
key_headlines.summary: The Korean government estimates that 84 trillion won will be needed over the next 10 years to expand power and water infrastructure for megaprojects, with 58 trillion won coming from the national budget. This funding plan was presented at a mega-growth special committee meeting in the National Assembly.

key_headlines.title: Japanese Deposit-Free Monthly Rent Guarantee Service Launches in South Korea
key_headlines.summary: Japanese rental guarantee company J.Reliance is set to enter the Korean market with a deposit-free monthly rental service that evaluates tenant creditworthiness instead of requiring large upfront deposits. This signals a shift in Korea's rental market from traditional jeonse (long-term deposits) to monthly rentals.

key_headlines.title: President Lee Calls for Stock Market Normalization Reform at Korea Exchange
key_headlines.summary: President Lee Jae-myung visited the Korea Exchange to emphasize capital market normalization as a key policy direction, stating 'if the goal is deep, the mountain will be high,' signaling commitment to market reform initiatives.

key_headlines.title: Government Launches 'Monthly Salary Defense Force' to Support Household Finances
key_headlines.summary: The government has launched a comprehensive inter-agency task force focused on alleviating living costs and increasing disposable income for workers across five areas: living expenses, childcare and elderly care, asset formation, job creation, and healthcare management.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Housing Market Shows Signs of Stabilization with Declining Price Growth and Rising Inventory
key_headlines.summary: The government announced that Seoul apartment price increases are decelerating (0.74% in September) and market listings are growing, indicating downward stabilization trends in the real estate market. An additional 44,000 housing units are planned for the Seoul metropolitan area by Q1 2027.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean economy is showing mixed signals with positive macroeconomic indicators but persistent challenges in household sentiment. The government has launched a 'Monthly Salary Defense Force' initiative to support worker living costs through increased rental allowances, childcare support, and asset-building programs. Additionally, President Lee visited the Korea Exchange to emphasize stock market normalization as a priority policy, while semiconductor megaproject infrastructure investment of 84 trillion won over 10 years was announced. The housing market is stabilizing with slowing price increases in Seoul and rising inventory levels, though regional disparities persist with reduced demand outside Seoul.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's economy has been upgraded from 'recovery mode' to 'steady growth' based on Q3-Q4 GDP growth of 1.0% quarter-over-quarter, supported by strong exports and investment performance. October employment figures showed improvement with 139,000 new jobs created year-over-year, and the unemployment rate declined to 2.0%. However, youth employment (ages 15-29) continues to decline for the 48th consecutive month, indicating structural challenges in the labor market. Import prices fell 1.8% in October following weakening won and declining international oil prices, though consumer price inflation remains at 2.8%, suggesting incomplete transmission of commodity price reductions to retail prices.
sections.Financial Markets: The stock market experienced volatility with KOSPI closing down 0.98% to 5,290.53 as semiconductor stocks faced downward pressure despite initial strength from foreign investor buying. U.S. Treasury yield expectations suggest rates will peak in early 2027 before declining, with the 10-year yield projected in the 4.30-5.20% range for next year. Securities firms face operational challenges from rising bond yields and evaluation losses on held securities, though those with strong asset management operations like NH Investment are showing defensive strength. Nvidia's leadership transition following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation has raised concerns about potential shifts in AI industry collaboration and investment patterns.
sections.Industry & Technology: SFC, a semiconductor and advanced materials company, announced medium to long-term growth strategies ahead of its KOSPI listing, focusing on OLED blue materials and expanding into PSF, biotech, and semiconductor materials businesses. The Korean automotive industry is addressing electric vehicle market challenges through industry discussions and insights sharing, with focus on achieving mass adoption of EVs. South Korea's secondary battery industry is pursuing a comeback leveraging AI data center demand growth, with the Pohang Battery Expo highlighting new opportunities. The semiconductor and tech sectors remain central to South Korea's industrial strategy, though facing increasing competition from global players.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment market is showing clear signs of stabilization with monthly price increases slowing from 1.27% in July to 0.74% in September, while housing inventory is rising as the government implements stabilization measures. However, demand remains heavily concentrated in Seoul, with 70% of apartment subscriptions in Gyeonggi Province failing to meet target quotas in recent offerings. The subscription market shows stark regional disparities, with Seoul and Gyeonggi accounting for 80% of national housing supply while provincial areas struggle with demand shortfalls. Future supply plans include 44,000 units for the Seoul metropolitan area through Q1 2027, as the government monitors the impact of extended jeonse conversion policies.
sections.International Economy: The Federal Reserve announced its 2027 FOMC meeting schedule with only 7 interest rate decisions (down from the typical 8), with October reserved for policy strategy discussions only. The U.S. is expected to reach peak interest rates by early 2027, followed by potential rate cuts in 2028, prompting investors to adjust long-duration bond strategies. Despite U.S. export restrictions on advanced semiconductors, Chinese AI projects remain heavily dependent on Nvidia chips with over 4.6 trillion won in contracted projects and equipment deals. Global financial institutions like Citigroup are intensifying engagement with South Korea's capital markets as the government pursues productive finance transformation and supports corporate innovation.
sections.AI & Economy: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation has raised questions about the company's future leadership and its ability to maintain its kingmaker role in the AI industry ecosystem, particularly regarding customer investments and open-source model support. Naver is pivoting away from its traditional advertising-focused business model to pursue growth in B2B, cloud services, and AI-powered personal agents as profit margins face pressure from market competition. Chinese AI companies are receiving substantial investment from entities allegedly connected to former Nvidia leadership, with undisclosed equity stakes backed by promises of advanced chip supply through grey markets. The transition in AI leadership and geopolitical tensions surrounding chip access are reshaping investment flows and development ecosystems across the global AI industry.
sections.Others: Japan's lower gasoline prices despite global oil availability are partly explained by weak yen dynamics: while commodity prices remain stable, depreciation reduces yen-denominated import costs, a benefit partially offset by fiscal pressures and declining tax revenues that weaken confidence in the currency. South Korea is accelerating legislation on the Digital Assets Basic Law to expand institutional and corporate investor participation in cryptocurrency markets, marking a significant shift in regulatory approach. The Future Response Fund faced mounting budget increase requests totaling over 25 trillion won from National Assembly standing committees despite fiscal sustainability concerns, reflecting political pressure to expand individual initiatives. U.S. Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin awarded a medal to an Army soldier who sternly reprimanded Austin and other officials for disruptive behavior at Arlington National Cemetery, highlighting military discipline priorities.
